description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for a dental practice, orthodontist, clinic, physio or any friendly healthcare provider, ready to make your own. Home, Treatments, Membership, The Team, New Patients and Contact share one calm, clean identity: mint backgrounds, a deep teal accent, Manrope headings and soft rounded cards. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. A split-image hero, a three-promise values row, a scrolling treatments strip, patient quotes, a booking form, a treatments accordion, a first-visit list, membership plans with a comparison table, insurance versus plan panels, a dentist team grid, a founder note, a first-visit steps and checklist and a what-happens-next timeline are all in place. Names, prices and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
